title.zh: Arkansas Sues Kalshi to Stop Alleged Illegal Gambling
title.en: Arkansas Sues Kalshi to Stop Alleged Illegal Gambling

current_state.zh: Arkansas sued Kalshi to stop its event contracts as alleged illegal gambling, seeking restitution, unpaid taxes, and civil penalties while Kalshi continues federal appeals against state gambling-law enforcement.
current_state.en: Arkansas sued Kalshi to stop its event contracts as alleged illegal gambling, seeking restitution, unpaid taxes, and civil penalties while Kalshi continues federal appeals against state gambling-law enforcement.
